title: Technology Transfer Evolves to Agricultural Innovation Systems Overview Video
reason: Describes the transition from linear technology transfer to agricultural innovation systems and their respective features and limitations.

tasks.task: Explain the linear technology transfer approach and its characteristics.

subtasks.text: Describe how the linear technology transfer approach works, starting with researchers, moving through the extension system, to farmers, marketers, and consumers.
Mention the focus of linear technology transfer on developing research capacity through investment.

tasks.task: Discuss the transitions from linear technology transfer to agricultural innovation systems and highlight key features of the innovation system.

subtasks.text: Describe the overview of various approaches over time, including technology transfer, farming systems analysis, agricultural knowledge and information systems, and agricultural innovation systems.
Explain the complexity of the agricultural innovation system and its interconnectedness of various stakeholders.
Describe the dynamic interactions between stakeholders in the agricultural innovation system.

tasks.task: Compare and contrast the linear technology transfer approach and the agricultural innovation system.

subtasks.text: Highlight the differences in decision-making processes between the linear technology transfer approach and the agricultural innovation system.
Mention the limitations of the linear technology transfer approach, such as unidirectional communication and missing diversity of voices.
Explain the focus on continuous learning and innovation in the agricultural innovation system.
